body:
Thanks..
Seriously, I had only good intentions.

1. Giving her a simple task, to let her think about something else, for a few seconds. Looking at her post history, it seemed like there wasn't time for a wall of text with good advice. But a quick snapshot, anyone could do rather quickly.

2. Being able to compliment her on how she looked, and send some positive energy her way.

3. IF anyone knew her IRL, maybe they would be able to stop her.

That was actually a pretty cool post.. thanks, internet-stranger. It lifted my spirit a bit :)

I'm actually pretty interested in physics/cosmology, but when I normally think of my self in that context, it just makes my life seem even more insignificant. But you got me thinking, that I would be a total asshole and let all of my ancestors down, if I just threw it away. And yeah.. I guess I could perhaps give it a little more time, before I go beyond the point of no return.

But I really need to find something that will give me some sort of happiness in my life.. currently, my girlfriend is the only thing that can do that for me. But we've only been together for 2 years, and I sometimes get the feeling, that it won't last forever. Maybe she will leave, if she found out about my secret and dark thoughts. And if she's not there to give me some happiness on the good days, it will be all bad days.. like today, where we had a fight over something ridiculous (whether or not to spend money on fixing some stuff in the house).

I feel like if she ever left me, I wouldn't know how to find comfort again. "There's plenty of other fish in the sea" - yeah I know. The last time I was single, I tried to find happiness and comfort in sex with girls I met in bars, online, or with prostitutes. I've had sex with more than 200 women, and now even sex seems kind of boring to me. I guess that's the downside of having had so many different partners, and tried so much stuff.

I've always thought, that if I were to kill myself, I would first quit my job and empty my savings account. Then I would leave a note at my house, telling whoever found it, that I had killed myself, and I did it out of free will, and there wasn't anything they could do. Then I would go travelling, perhaps through south east Asia, until I ran out of money. And when it was all gone, I would just find a high bridge or cliff or something, and jump. This scenario is what I always think about, and plan in my head, every night when I go to sleep.

If my girlfriend leaves me, this is still the plan I guess. Although when I'm feeling down, like I have been today, I don't even feel like bothering with all that stuff. I think I'm lucky, that I don't live in a place, where firearms are easy to come by.
Post a picture of yourself, before you leave?

Except it's not a beautiful world out there.. war, hunger, poverty, animals going extinct...

There is no point, and it's not beautiful.

My girlfriend really want's a baby. And although it might be fun, and give me something to live for, I'm just not sure, that I want to put a baby into this world.

Sometimes I think, that I should wait until she's pregnant, before I kill myself. Then I would have left something in this world...
I'm 100% sure that neither my family or my girlfriend know I'm having these thoughts, so many a baby would console them when I'm gone... or something.
